display.name: CMTC trust profile and issuer succession
Profile lease left, seconds
display.description: Seconds until the published profile expires, per cluster. 15 to 30 s while the producer renews (15 to 27 s over the hour to 2026-10-26T04:50Z); below 10 s renewals are failing; below 0 the profile lapsed (CMTCIssuerProfileLapsed). No data: no scraped controller, or a withdrawn profile.

display.name: Approval source read, seconds ago
display.description: Seconds since the leader last read its approval source, per cluster. It reads every 5 s (at most 10 s over the hour to 2026-10-26T04:50Z); above 60 s the producer cannot read it (CMTCIssuerProfileSourceStale).

display.name: Source validations not accepted, 1 hour
display.description: Approval source reads that were rejected or unavailable in the last hour, per cluster. 0 is normal; the controller log line "approval validation rejected" has the reason.

spec.query: sum by (cluster) (increase(cmtc_issuer_profile_validation_attempts_total{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", result!="accepted", cluster="cmtc-a"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)

sum by (cluster) (increase(cmtc_issuer_profile_validation_attempts_total{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", result!="accepted", cluster="cmtc-b"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

display.name: Publication writes failed, 1 hour
display.description: Publication writes the API server did not acknowledge in the last hour, per cluster. 0 is normal.

spec.query: sum by (cluster) (increase(cmtc_issuer_profile_publication_writes_total{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", result="error", cluster="cmtc-a"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)

sum by (cluster) (increase(cmtc_issuer_profile_publication_writes_total{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", result="error", cluster="cmtc-b"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

display.name: Profile lease left, seconds
display.description: The lease over time, per cluster: a saw-tooth between about 15 and 30 s. A line falling through 0 is a lapse.

display.name: Publication writes per second
display.description: Acknowledged and failed publication writes, per cluster, 5 minute rate: about one every 10 s while the producer renews (361 and 360 in the hour to 2026-10-26T04:50Z).

spec.text: The producer works when the lease saw-tooth stays above 0 and every read and write is accepted. This is the publication; whether ztunnel applied it is the last section.

display.name: Approval in force, per cluster · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). The approval generation each cluster's producer accepted and the hours until it ends (the earliest notAfter it pins, or its expiresAt). Both clusters should accept the same generation (CMTCIssuerApprovalGenerationsDiffer).

display.name: Pinned issuers, per approval cluster · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). For each cluster the approval lists: hours until its newest and oldest pinned issuer end, and until SPIRE prepares and activates the CA that follows the newest. Negative hours: already happened.

spec.query: (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0)) / 2, 2592000) - time()) / 3600

(max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest"} > 0)) / 6, 604800) - time()) / 3600

display.name: Profile withdrawn, per cluster · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). Whether each producer publishes a validated profile (validated) or withdrew it (withdrawn), over time. The table names the reason.

display.name: Publication reason now · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). The reason each producer gives for its publication: Validated, or why it withdrew the profile (SourceExpired, SourceInvalid, SourceDeleted, SourceUnavailable, SourceUIDMismatch, SourceChanged, GenerationRollback).

spec.text: The approval pins at most two issuers per cluster. While SPIRE holds a CA it does not pin, the next CA activation is a deadline.

display.name: Hours until SPIRE activates an unpinned CA · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). The soonest activation, over the clusters the approval lists, of a CA it does not pin, per cluster. Critical below 2 h; past 0 the activation happened and ztunnel refuses new certificates.

spec.query: (min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0)) / 6, 604800)) - time()) / 3600

(min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0)) / 6, 604800)) - time()) / 3600

display.name: Hours until SPIRE prepares the next CA · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). The soonest preparation of the CA that follows the newest pin, per cluster. Negative: SPIRE has prepared it and it must be added to a new approval generation (CMTCIssuerSuccessionDue).

spec.query: (min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0)) / 2, 2592000)) - time()) / 3600

(min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0)) / 2, 2592000)) - time()) / 3600

display.name: Hours until SPIRE activates an unpinned CA · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0001 (approval and approved issuer gauges). The same countdown over time, per cluster. A new approval generation that pins the prepared CA moves the line up by the CA's lifetime.

spec.query: (min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-a"} > 0)) / 6, 604800)) - time()) / 3600

(min by (cluster) (max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - clamp_max((max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_after_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0) - max by (cluster, approval_cluster) (cmtc_issuer_profile_approved_issuer_not_before_timestamp_seconds{job="cmtc", component="cmtc-controller", position="newest", cluster="cmtc-b"} > 0)) / 6, 604800)) - time()) / 3600

display.name: SPIRE CA times, per cluster · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0002 (SPIRE telemetry) and the spire-server scrape job of deploy/. Hours until SPIRE's active CA ends, and until the latest CA it holds (active or prepared) ends, per cluster SPIRE runs in. A latest CA beyond every pin is a prepared CA the approval does not pin (CMTCSPIRECANotApproved).

spec.text:
On 2026-10-25, SPIRE prepared slot B at 15:55:19Z and activated it at 23:55:17Z: an 8 hour window these panels would have counted down.
#34, 2026-10-26: approval generation 5 pinned SPIRE slot A only. The same arithmetic forecasts the activation at 23:55:28Z (cmtc-a) and 23:55:54Z (cmtc-b); spire-server-0 logged it at 23:55:37Z and 23:55:57Z (rules/proposed/issuer-approval-source-change.rules.yaml).

display.name: Issuer profile messages received by ztunnel per second · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. IssuerProfile xDS messages each cluster's ztunnels received, per cluster, 5 minute rate. A flat 0 while the producer renews means ztunnel is not receiving its profile.

display.name: Connections refused over the trust profile per second · planned
display.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/ztunnel/0001 (TRUST_PROFILE) and the ztunnel scrape job. Connections ztunnel refused because its profile does not accept a certificate, per cluster, 5 minute rate (CMTCTrustProfileRefusingConnections).

display.name: Connections failed for want of a workload identity per second · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. Connections that failed because ztunnel had no certificate for the workload (IDENTITY_ERROR), per cluster, 5 minute rate: SPIRE identity issuance is failing.

spec.text: The profile reaches ztunnel over xDS. Refusals over the profile are the outage of 2026-10-25; IDENTITY_ERROR is SPIRE not issuing.

display.name: Mesh certificates, per cluster · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the cert-manager scrape job of deploy/. Each cert-manager Certificate: its issuer, hours until it expires and until cert-manager renews it, and its Ready condition, now. The mesh root cmtc-mesh-root-ca lives 10 years in the control cluster only, the ClusterMesh and SPIRE intermediates 1 year, the ClusterMesh and ztunnel leaves 1 day (MESH_PKI.md). Negative hours to renewal: the renewal is overdue (CMTCCertificateRenewalOverdue).

spec.query: max by (cluster, exported_namespace, name, issuer_name) (certmanager_certificate_ready_status{job="cert-manager", condition="True"})

display.name: ClusterIssuers not Ready · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the cert-manager scrape job of deploy/. ClusterIssuers whose Ready condition is not True, per cluster, now: the mesh root, the per-cluster intermediates and the SPIRE issuer. Normal: 0 (CMTCClusterIssuerNotReady).

spec.query: count by (cluster) (max by (cluster, name) (certmanager_clusterissuer_ready_status{job="cert-manager", condition!="True", cluster="cmtc-a"}) == 1) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cert-manager", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)

count by (cluster) (max by (cluster, name) (certmanager_clusterissuer_ready_status{job="cert-manager", condition!="True", cluster="cmtc-b"}) == 1) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cert-manager", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

display.name: Hours until the soonest intermediate expires · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the cert-manager scrape job of deploy/. Hours until the first of the cluster's ClusterMesh and SPIRE intermediate certificates expires, per cluster. They were issued for 1 year on 2026-10-26 and renew 30 days before they end.

display.name: Bundle reconcile errors, 1 hour · proposed
display.description: Proposed: needs the trust-manager scrape job of deploy/. Failed reconciles of trust-manager's Bundle controller in the last hour, per cluster. The Bundle cmtc-mesh-root copies the mesh root into ConfigMap cmtc-mesh-root of every namespace labelled trust: enabled. Normal: 0 (CMTCTrustBundleReconcileFailing).

spec.query: sum by (cluster) (increase(controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total{job="trust-manager", controller="bundles", cluster="cmtc-a"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="trust-manager", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)

sum by (cluster) (increase(controller_runtime_reconcile_errors_total{job="trust-manager", controller="bundles", cluster="cmtc-b"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="trust-manager", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

spec.text:
Read on the labs at 2026-10-27T00:06:53Z: every Certificate Ready; the four intermediates end 2027-10-26T12:49Z, cmtc-mesh-root-ca 2036-10-23T12:49Z; 6 Bundle reconciles and 0 errors on cmtc-a.
cert-manager's metrics describe the certificates it manages, not the ones SPIRE issues: SPIRE's CA times are in the section above.
